subject: Math
skill: Nonlinear Equations In One Variable And Systems Of Equations In Two Variables
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The graph of a system of two equations is shown. What is the x-coordinate of one of the solutions to the system?
explanation: The solutions to the system are the intersection points of the graphs. From the graph, the parabola and line intersect at $(-1, 2)$ and $(1, 0)$. Among the answer choices, $-1$ is the x-coordinate of one intersection point.
